title.en: An Act Establishing a Land Transportation Office District Office in the Municipality of Consolacion, Province of Cebu, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Land Transportation Office District Office in the Municipality of Consolacion, Province of Cebu, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Văn phòng Khu vực Land Transportation Office tại Đô thị Consolacion, Tỉnh Cebu, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสำนักงานเขต Land Transportation Office ในเทศบาล Consolacion จังหวัด Cebu และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Kantor Distrik Land Transportation Office di Kotamadya Consolacion, Provinsi Cebu, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Pejabat Daerah Land Transportation Office di Perbandaran Consolacion, Wilayah Cebu, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There is hereby established a district office of Land Transportation Office (LTO) to be located in the Municipality of Consolacion, Province of Cebu.

The Secretary of the Department of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the LTO District Office in the Municipality of Consolacion, Province of Cebu, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
